records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the three and six months ended June 30, 2024, we generated $265.3 million and $519.9 million in total revenue, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue mix for the three months ended June 30, 2024 and six months ended June 30, 2024 was: cloud subscriptions 31%; software license 1%; maintenance 13%; services 52%; and hardware 3%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our international revenue was approximately $88.8 million and $172.5 million for the three and six months ended June 30, 2024, respectively, which represents approximately 33% of our total revenue for both three and six months ended June 30, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our R&D expenses were $35.3 million and $70.3 million for the three and six months ended June 30, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three and six months ended June 30, 2024, we generated cash flow from operating activities of $73.3 million and $128.0 million, respectively.
